[[File:Great pentakis dodecahedron.stl|thumb|3D model of a great pentakis dodecahedron]]
In [[geometry]], the '''great pentakis dodecahedron''' is a nonconvex [[Isohedral figure|isohedral]] [[polyhedron]].

It is the [[Dual polyhedron|dual]] of the [[uniform star polyhedron|uniform]] [[small stellated truncated dodecahedron]]. The [[pentagon]]al faces pass close to the center in the uniform polyhedron, causing this dual to be very ''spikey''. It has 60 intersecting [[Triangle#Types of triangle|isosceles triangle]] faces. Part of each triangle lies within the solid, hence is invisible in solid models.

== Proportions ==
The triangles have one very acute angle of <math>\arccos(\frac{1}{10}+\frac{2}{5}\sqrt{5})\approx 6.051\,689\,017\,91^{\circ}</math> and two of <math>\arccos(\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{5}\sqrt{5})\approx 86.974\,155\,491\,04^{\circ}</math>. The [[dihedral angle]] equals <math>\arccos(\frac{-24+5\sqrt{5}}{41})\approx 108.220\,490\,680\,83^{\circ}</math>.
